ABOUT US 
 SAG Digital is a subsidiary of Swiss Automotive Group AG (SAG), a leading company in the independent automotive aftermarket across Europe. With a strong presence in 12 countries, SAG generates annual sales exceeding 1.1 billion euros. At our offices in Germany, Switzerland, and Romania, we design, develop, and operate innovative e-commerce solutions, webshops, and apps for SAG companies. Our expertise spans cloud/DevOps, Agile software development, ERP, logistics, and IT security, enabling us to drive digital transformation in the automotive aftermarket.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 In order to ensure a continuous, successful growth, the group is setting up a new IT Solution Center, which will provide complete software solutions for the companies within the group and external partners. We are hiring for our software development center in Cluj-Napoca motivated, proactive personalities in software development area, interested in a successful and long-term collaboration. You will work with other members of the development team to design, develop, unit test, support, and maintain software, web applications and ETL processes using a variety of technologies with focus on .NET.
 WHAT YOU BRING 
5+ years of hands-on working with .NET 8 +, ORM tools (Entity Framework) and React
Strong knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js
Experience with message queuing systems and asynchronous processing patterns
Good understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven systems
Hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL
Solid experience with testing and mocking frameworks
Strong understanding of OOP design principles and best practices
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration of back-end services
Experience in developing end-to-end web applications
Experience with Azure Cloud provider (PaaS Services, IaC tools like Terraform), source code repositories GitHub, CI/CD tools and practices
Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking
Hands-on experience using AI tools for productivity and efficiency
 WHAT WE OFFER 
Flexible working hours and remote options
Continuous learning with a guaranteed training budget
Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
13th salary
Regular team events like summer parties and office gatherings
Private health insurance
A diverse and international team culture
 Welcome to SAG Digital: Your Future Awaits! 
 Join us and be part of a dynamic team driving digital innovation in the automotive aftermarket. Shape the future of e-commerce with us – we look forward to meeting you!
